Notes.Text:
This update for webkit2gtk3 fixes the following issues:
    
WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit Security Advisory WSA-2026-0007 (bsc#1290913):

- CVE-2026-86922: type confusion in WebKit web content processing can lead to arbitrary code execution.
- CVE-2026-86973: out-of-bounds read in WebKit can lead to unexpected process crash or memory disclosure.
- CVE-2026-86974: type confusion in WebKit can lead to memory corruption when processing crafted web content.
- CVE-2026-86985: improper input validation in WebKit can lead to an unexpected process crash.
- CVE-2026-86986: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process crash.
- CVE-2026-112599: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process crash.
- CVE-2026-112615: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process termination.
- CVE-2026-112623: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to arbitrary code execution.
- CVE-2026-112626: use-after-free in WebKit JavaScript Bindings can lead to arbitrary code execution.
- CVE-2026-112637: use-after-free in WebKit Canvas can lead to arbitrary code execution.
- CVE-2026-112639: use-after-free in WebRTC can lead to arbitrary code execution when processing crafted web content.
- CVE-2026-112640: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to memory corruption.
- CVE-2026-112651: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to arbitrary code execution.
- CVE-2026-112653: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process termination.
- CVE-2026-112654: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process termination.
- CVE-2026-112655: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to arbitrary code execution.
- CVE-2026-112666: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process termination.
- CVE-2026-112673: type confusion in WebKit state handling can lead to an unexpected process termination.
- CVE-2026-112684: improper state management in WebKit can lead to an unexpected process crash.
- CVE-2026-112686: race condition due to improper locking in WebKit can lead to unexpected process termination or
  memory corruption.
- CVE-2026-112693: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process crash.
- CVE-2026-112695: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process termination.
- CVE-2026-113897: protection mechanism failure in WebKit Process Model can allow a remote attacker to escape the Web
  Content sandbox.
- CVE-2026-113901: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process crash.
- CVE-2026-113903: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to unexpected memory modification.
- CVE-2026-113904: use-after-free in WebKit memory management can lead to an unexpected process crash.

Vulnerabilities.Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed with improved memory management. This issue is fixed in Safari 27.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
